structure.notes: Cobalt(ii) oxide, built from the deposited CIF (COD 1533087). The density and first-shell checks use the same coordinates, so they check the transcription and symmetry, not the structure against an independent value.

source.reference: X-ray density of the deposited cell; Sasaki, Satoshi et al., PJABDW 55, 43 (1979)
